config.description: Optional OpenMercantil API key (omk_...). Without it the server uses the anonymous free tier (60 requests/min, 200/day per IP).

config.label: Local cap on requests per minute across all tools
config.description: Local cap on requests per minute across all tools. Defaults to 60 (the anonymous tier limit); raise it for paid plans.

config.label: Maximum size of a tool response in characters; larger results are cut with a notice
config.description: Maximum size of a tool response in characters; larger results are cut with a notice. Defaults to 60000.
